Jordan / Priyom —

Quick review of the attached usage_report.csv and the redacted email chains: a few signals to call out:

- Multiple account identifiers map back to a small set of IP ranges and two repeating billing emails (same domain, different aliases). That can be legitimate (dev infra) but is a known pattern we've seen in coordinated retries.
- Several top-up requests came within minutes of an initial trial reset; timestamps align with automated scripts in prior cases.
- Token consumption per account is highly bursty and then idle — consistent with sandbox experiments shared across teams but also typical of scripted replay.

Recommendation: hold on any >20k extension until TrustBridge provides either (A) a single billing contact + PO and a list of expected account owners, or (B) if they need multi-account seats, we issue separate trial seats with per-seat limits and monitoring. For immediate unblock we can provision a temporary 10k shared sandbox token pool that expires in 7 days.

If they provide PO and confirmed account list we can escalate to a temporary 50k seat with one-time approval and monitoring.
